sentences.say: Purpose.

sentences.text: LLM applications are the point of this course, and the word "agent" is used for everything from a chatbot with a plug-in to a system that runs for hours.
sentences.say: LLM applications are the point of this course, and the word "agent" is used for everything from a chatbot with a plug-in to a system that runs for hours.

sentences.text: This chapter gives you a precise vocabulary: what an agent is, the levels of agency, and the standard workflow patterns, so that you can choose the simplest design that works.
sentences.say: This chapter gives you a precise vocabulary: what an agent is, the levels of agency, and the standard workflow patterns, so that you can choose the simplest design that works.

sentences.text: Key ideas
sentences.say: Key ideas

sentences.text: An LLM on its own cannot look anything up or run anything.
sentences.say: An LLM on its own cannot look anything up or run anything.

sentences.text: Tools connect it to the real world.
sentences.say: Tools connect it to the real world.

sentences.text: Everyone defines "agent" a little differently, but three things recur: an LLM, tools and some autonomy.
sentences.say: Everyone defines "agent" a little differently, but three things recur: an LLM, tools and some autonomy.

sentences.text: Agency is a spectrum.
sentences.say: Agency is a spectrum.

sentences.text: Level 1 is an LLM plus tools, level 2 is a fixed workflow of LLM steps, level 3 is an LLM in a loop.
sentences.say: Level 1 is an LLM plus tools, level 2 is a fixed workflow of LLM steps, level 3 is an LLM in a loop.

sentences.text: Anthropic describes five workflow patterns: chaining, routing, parallelization, orchestrator-workers and evaluator-optimizer.
sentences.say: Anthropic describes five workflow patterns: chaining, routing, parallelization, orchestrator-workers and evaluator-optimizer.

sentences.text: 16.1 An LLM alone lives in imagination land
sentences.say: 16.1 An LLM alone lives in imagination land

sentences.text: Shaw Talebi's phrase: out of the box an LLM lives in an imagined reality, built from its training data.
sentences.say: Shaw Talebi's phrase: out of the box an LLM lives in an imagined reality, built from its training data.

sentences.text: It cannot search the web, so anything recent it makes up.
sentences.say: It cannot search the web, so anything recent it makes up.

sentences.text: It cannot run code, so if you ask for the output of a program, it invents one.
sentences.say: It cannot run code, so if you ask for the output of a program, it invents one.

sentences.text: This is why hallucinations are a problem.
sentences.say: This is why hallucinations are a problem.

sentences.text: Tools take an LLM from imagination into the real world and give it real feedback.
sentences.say: Tools take an LLM from imagination into the real world and give it real feedback.

sentences.text: The second reason agents beat plain chatbots is test-time compute: the more tokens a model generates while it works on a problem, the better the answer, which is why reasoning models that "think" before answering can solve harder tasks without detailed instructions.
sentences.say: The second reason agents beat plain chatbots is test-time compute: the more tokens a model generates while it works on a problem, the better the answer, which is why reasoning models that "think" before answering can solve harder tasks without detailed instructions.

sentences.text: (Reasoning models such as DeepSeek R1 and OpenAI's o1 are trained with reinforcement learning, Chapter 2.)

sentences.text: 16.2 What is an agent?
sentences.say: 16.2 What is an agent?

sentences.text: Three definitions, from three organizations:
sentences.say: Three definitions, from three organizations:

sentences.text: OpenAI: an LLM configured with instructions and tools.
sentences.say: OpenAI: an LLM configured with instructions and tools.

sentences.text: Hugging Face: a system where an LLM executes complex tasks through planning and using tools.
sentences.say: Hugging Face: a system where an LLM executes complex tasks through planning and using tools.

sentences.text: Anthropic: a system where LLMs dynamically direct their own processes and tool usage, staying in control of how they accomplish tasks.
sentences.say: Anthropic: a system where LLMs dynamically direct their own processes and tool usage, staying in control of how they accomplish tasks.

sentences.text: They differ: OpenAI's is about tools, Hugging Face adds planning, and Anthropic's stresses autonomy.
sentences.say: They differ: OpenAI's is about tools, Hugging Face adds planning, and Anthropic's stresses autonomy.

sentences.text: Practitioners rarely argue about it.
sentences.say: Practitioners rarely argue about it.

sentences.text: They talk about agentic systems and ask how much agency one has.
sentences.say: They talk about agentic systems and ask how much agency one has.

sentences.text: Three features show up in every definition: there is an LLM at the centre; it has tools; and there is some autonomy, meaning it can plan, reflect on its own output and use real-world feedback.
sentences.say: Three features show up in every definition: there is an LLM at the centre; it has tools; and there is some autonomy, meaning it can plan, reflect on its own output and use real-world feedback.

sentences.text: Context window: everything the model can see at once: instructions, conversation, tool results.

sentences.text: It is finite and costs money per token.

sentences.text: Tool schema: the description of a tool (name, purpose, parameters) that the model reads in order to decide how to call it.

sentences.text: Tool call and tool result: the model's request to run a tool, and what you send back.

sentences.text: Turn and trajectory: one round of the loop, and the full sequence of messages and tool calls.
